method.whole_page_contacts: Personally inspected every assigned page on 29 labelled whole-page contact sheets using view_image detail=original.
method.native_folios: Personally inspected the full native footer strip of every assigned page on 20 labelled folio sheets, checking visible number, sequence, side, clipping and empty margin.
method.new_pages: Personally inspected actual native full-page renders for all 17 index pages and the one inserted blank in scope. Labelled full-size proof wrappers were hash-checked, but are not claimed as separately viewed.
method.inherited_detail: Only the 441 pages with exact current source-to-combined header/body RGB equality inherit previously accepted source detail. Current source PDF/master/TeX identities and source review bindings were rechecked. Contact inspection and footer inspection are new.
method.pixel_comparison: System.Drawing without color management decodes every raster to top-down RGB8; exact channel-byte equality above the footer, with SHA-256 receipts and mismatch pixel bounds. PNG-filter prefix hashes are an independent sufficient equality check, not the final comparison criterion.

footer_exclusion.guard_expectation: Every RGB channel is 255 in the full-width blank gap around the cutoff.

method.hash_verification: All 459 assigned actual-page PNGs, 441 corresponding source PNGs, 67 selected proof artifacts, seven source PDFs/master/TeX identities, source-acceptance receipt hashes, and final PDF/manifests checked against current bytes before saving.
method.reviewer_role_limit: This is a visual assembly review. The reviewer previously authored the sound-history appendix and some index proposals; linguistic/source accuracy and semantic index acceptance are not independently recertified here.
other_limits: Whole-page contacts are not treated as a new character-by-character reading of all retained pages; inherited detail requires exact current source pixel equality.
PDF links were not all interactively clicked in this review. Navigation and complete text parity are checked separately by the coordinator.
Only physical pages 513–971 are accepted by this receipt; visible pages 505–512 on the first folio sheet are outside this scope.

observations: All assigned page layouts remain within the page bounds, with intact headers and margins; no collision, clipping or page-order defect was found.
Visible folios run from 501 through 959 with the intentional blank 552 unprinted on physical page 564; alternating placement is consistent.
Unit 16, Unit 17, Unit 18, the sound-history appendix and both glossaries begin in the expected order and preserve accepted source layout.

All 17 index pages were read visually at native full-page size: columns, headings, subentries, page references, cross-references and special characters are legible. New subject, dual-agreement and gender-reference routes are visibly present.
The source-page acceptance records remain historical and unchanged; this receipt binds their inherited detail to the current assembled PDF through the new exact-pixel comparison.
